order: Fix a finding where a pre-add snapshot failure, combined with an alias being added and then removed, leaves a stranded canonical registration. The pre-add read must complete successfully before anything is ever registered — refusing the operation up front, never registering first and validating after. A post-add read failure must be retried rather than treated as fatal. Prove that the residual opportunistic-registration path self-heals: an alias-created registration that never reaches active state must be reclaimed by the standing sweep on the next checkout creation, and only the standing sweep may reclaim it — no other path should intervene. Pin a regression that leaves neither the directory nor the registration behind once the sweep runs; the test must fail if either survives. Record the review verdict verbatim in the roster, and keep the tranche status accurately reflecting that further review remains outstanding.
claims: The pre-add porcelain read now refuses before registering anything, a post-add read failure is retried, and the residual opportunistic-registration path's stranding is proven self-healing: an alias-created, never-active registration is reclaimed by the standing sweep at the next checkout creation, pinned as a regression showing both the directory and the registration gone. The review verdict was recorded verbatim; the tranche remains open. Suites: verifier 101, router 135, registry 31, review-lane 116, full CI-equivalent run green.
